* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered

* Live in SoCal

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Company Overview**
====================


Each year, 2\.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics.


Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall\-E\-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self\-driving in the home” with real\-time 3D mapping, adaptive path\-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on\-device.

**Privacy First**
-----------------


What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud.

**Our Approach**
----------------


Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single\-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Matic is a tight\-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra\-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy.

**About the role**
==================


Matic is building the next generation of consumer home robotics. Small team, high ownership, moving fast. We're looking for a Robotics Customer Success Intern to own ticket resolution end\-to\-end.  

  

This is a hands\-on role. You'll be in the weeds with customers every day: running onboarding, answering tickets, and closely collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams. You'll help build the systems, playbooks, and infrastructure that let us deliver a deeply personal experience to every single customer as we grow from ten thousand to a hundred thousand and beyond.  

  

We believe that the best customer service is no customer service, a product so intuitive and reliable that customers never need to reach out. The second\-best is just\-in\-time, self\-service help that anticipates questions before they're asked. You'll build both: proactive systems that eliminate friction, and a white\-glove experience for the moments that matter most.  

  

**What you’ll do:**  

  

**Deliver a Three\-Michelin\-Star Customer Experience**

* Own tickets end\-to\-end. First response to resolution. No missed replies, no open threads, no customer left hanging.
* Diagnose bugs, walk customers through fixes, and coordinate repairs or replacements when needed.
* Escalate the hard ones to Engineering, Product, or Ops, and drive them to closure.
* Analyze customer issue data obsessively. Spot patterns across tickets. Surface recurring issues, root causes, and product gaps to the team so the same problem doesn't hit a second customer.
* Develop deep product knowledge across hardware, software, algorithms, and the Matic app. Know the product inside and out: every component, every edge case, every workaround.
* Develop and deploy AI tools such as skills and agents to improve response times and support quality, and build a feedback loop that results in continuous improvement of customer success processes

**What we look for:**

* Deep customer empathy paired with a bias toward action. You care about the customer, and you move fast to resolve the issue.
* Technical curiosity. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how a complex hardware \+ software \+ AI product works well enough to troubleshoot, explain, and advocate intelligently.
* Bachelor's degree completed or in progress. Technical or analytical background preferred.
* This role can be a path to full\-time for the right candidate, based on performance and team needs.

**What we value:**

* Customer obsession. Every interaction, every email, every call, every unboxing, should feel like the customer is the most important person in the world. Because to us, they are.
* Details, details, details. The difference between good and exceptional lives in the details. You catch what others miss and you care about things other people think don't matter.
* Ownership and follow\-through. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, you fill the gap, and you make sure it stays filled. No ball gets dropped.
* Analytical rigor. You back up intuition with data. You measure what matters, you know what good looks like, and you hold yourself and your team to it.

 **We'd love to hear from you if...**

* You're the kind of person who reads every customer review, the good ones and the bad ones, because you genuinely care about how people experience a product.
* You love the challenge of diagnosing complex, cross\-functional problems, the ones that span hardware, software, logistics, and human psychology.
* You get fired up about consumer robotics and the idea of putting an extraordinary product into people's homes.
* You're excited to do your life's work.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Weekend availability. We support our customers seven days a week, so the team rotates weekend coverage. You won't work every weekend, but you'll take your turn.

  

**Compensation:**
-----------------


Base: $25\- $35/hour.  

  

Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Exceptional storyteller: You excel at presenting to diverse audiences, staying cool under pressure, and making complex concepts simple and engaging.  

  

Deep ecosystem knowledge: You understand how our hardware, software, and services integrate, and you're passionate about sharing the Apple story and helping others learn.  

  

Strategic business acumen: You are genuinely curious about how organizations operate, with a solid grasp of budget cycles, IT constraints, and AI ambitions.  

  

Consultative sales style: You know that the best sales conversations start with listening, using curiosity to qualify opportunities effectively rather than just pushing a pitch.  

  

Executive presence: You are comfortable and confident leading strategic conversations with senior decision\-makers, including CIOs, Superintendents, and VPs of IT.  

  

Brand evangelist: You are confident introducing Claris to leaders who may not yet be familiar with the brand.  

  

Value\-driven mindset: You are motivated by building meaningful, long\-term solutions rather than just chasing the fastest opportunities in the funnel.  

  

Partnership focus: You understand (or are eager to learn) Apple’s sales motion, viewing our partnerships as co\-selling relationships that require care, consistency, and mutual value.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\+ minimum years experience in business development, enterprise account management, or strategic sales \- ideally in a pre\-category or market\-creation environment  

  

An entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working in a startup\-like atmosphere on a small team  

  

Demonstrated ability to work without an established playbook \- you build the motion as you go  

  

Consultative approach to customer engagement; you ask more than you pitch  

  

Experience working within or alongside a channel partner model  

  

Strong written and verbal communication \- you can debrief clearly, document accurately, and present confidently  

  

Ability to travel regularly for customer meetings, conferences, EBC appearances, and field events (up to 50% domestic travel)

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $139,300 and $209,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**FullTerra / Clean Vapor**
===========================


**Assistant Project Manager**
-----------------------------


**Location:** Atlanta, GA, with travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area


**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt


### **Build Your Career in Environmental Construction**



Clean Vapor, a FullTerra company, is a specialty contractor providing vapor intrusion mitigation installation services for commercial and residential properties throughout the Atlanta market.



We are looking for an **Assistant Project Manager** to support the planning, coordination, and execution of vapor intrusion mitigation projects. You will work closely with Project Managers, field crews, subcontractors, clients, and trade partners to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and according to project requirements.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with construction or environmental project experience who wants to grow into a Project Manager role within a specialized area of the environmental construction industry.


### **What You'll Do**


**Project Coordination**


* Assist Project Managers with the day\-to\-day coordination of vapor intrusion mitigation installations, including sub\-slab depressurization systems, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane venting
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, equipment, and material deliveries
* Help keep multiple active projects organized and on schedule
* Participate in client meetings and provide project progress updates
* Serve as an on\-site point of contact for subcontractors and trade partners during installation


**Plans, Documentation \& Compliance**


* Review site plans, system layouts, specifications, and approved designs
* Help verify installations are completed according to project requirements and applicable standards
* Maintain project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, punch lists, photo logs, and closeout packages
* Assist with permitting, site access agreements, and coordination with property owners and facility managers
* Support OSHA requirements and site\-specific health and safety plans


**Budgeting \& Estimating**


* Track project budgets, change orders, and daily field reports
* Identify and communicate potential scope or cost deviations to the Project Manager
* Prepare quantity takeoffs and assist with estimating for future projects as needed

### **What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* 1\-3\+ years of experience in construction project coordination, environmental remediation, or a related field
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Environmental Science, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple active projects
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area
* OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification, or willingness to obtain certification within 90 days of hire


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with vapor intrusion or vapor mitigation projects
* Knowledge of vapor intrusion mitigation systems and methods, including sub\-slab depressurization, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane depressurization
* Familiarity with ASTM E2121 and applicable state or EPA vapor intrusion guidance
* Experience using Bluebeam, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar construction/project management software

### **Physical \& Work Requirements**


* Ability to visit and work around active construction and installation sites
* Ability to access areas such as residential crawlspaces, commercial slabs, mechanical spaces, and below\-grade areas while using appropriate PPE
* Comfortable working around slab penetration equipment and mechanical fans
* Ability to lift approximately 25\-40 lbs
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods during site visits

### **What You'll Get**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company\-matched 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid vacation and paid holidays
* Vehicle/mileage allowance for travel between job sites
* Professional development support
* Opportunity to grow into a full Project Manager role

### **Join Clean Vapor**



If you're an organized, detail\-oriented construction or environmental professional looking to develop your project management career, we'd like to hear from you.


*FullTerra / Clean Vapor is an equal opportunity employer.*

**Design/Build Project Coordinator (CAD, Construction Detailing, Estimating)**  
Reveal Design LLC \| Chicago Western Suburbs \| Full Time, 4 Day Work Week

**Why this job is different**

* 4 day work week. Monday through Thursday, 40 to 45 hours. Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays are off
* Two weeks paid vacation every year around Christmas and New Year's.
* Family run business. You will work directly with the owner, not through three layers of management.
* Occasional email check or a random item outside those hours, but the 3 day weekend is real and we protect it.

**About us**  
We are a small, premium design\-build company specializing in high\-end outdoor living: louvered pergolas, rooftop decks, outdoor kitchens, and weatherproof aluminum cabinetry. We have been at this for 15 years. Because we are small, everyone wears several hats and no one hides behind a job title. We are hiring this role specifically to help us grow.

**The role**  
You are the person who takes a design, figures out how it actually gets built, draws it, prices it, and then makes sure the field crew has what they need to execute it. Half office, half job site.

**What you will do**

* Produce construction drawings, elevations, sections, details, and shop drawings
* Turn design concepts and hand sketches into accurate, buildable documents
* Prepare proposals, material takeoffs, and project costing; maintain project info in LMN
* Coordinate crews, subs, vendors, deliveries, inspections, and schedules
* Visit job sites to verify dimensions, review installation details, and check quality
* Give foremen clear instructions, dimensions, and details, and troubleshoot field conditions with them
* Support the Project Manager on change orders, scheduling, and daily project documentation

**What you need**

* 3\+ years in construction, landscape construction, architecture, or design\-build
* Advanced SketchUp and LayOut
* Advanced AutoCAD
* Ability to produce professional construction and shop drawings and read plans and specs
* Strong hand and field sketching
* Solid working knowledge of outdoor construction: hardscape, pavers, natural stone, masonry, decks, pergolas, fencing and screens, outdoor kitchens, grading and drainage
* Working familiarity with irrigation, landscape lighting, low voltage electrical, roofing and waterproofing, and planting
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites
* LMN experience is a plus, not a requirement

**Who fits here**  
A construction\-minded designer who is comfortable in both the office and the field. You can look at a design, understand how it needs to be built, draw and detail it, price it, and then explain it clearly to the crew. You are organized, you communicate well with clients and tradespeople alike, and you are happy in a small company where the work varies week to week.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**

*iSonic Inc. \| On\-site \| Full\-Time*

We're building out the B2B side of iSonic and need one person to own it end to end — from the first quote a wholesale customer sends us, through the order, through the dealer or distributor relationship that supports it, and through the warranty claim that might come two years later. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who wants to build a function, not just staff one.

**About iSonic**

iSonic Inc. designs and sells ultrasonic cleaners and related accessories, serving both individual consumers through our online store and B2B customers — dental practices, medical offices, and industrial buyers — who purchase at volume through quotes and wholesale terms. We work closely with our manufacturing partners to keep our product line reliable and our customers taken care of when something goes wrong.

**About the Role**

Twelve months from now, you'll have built and be running the full B2B pipeline — quoting, order fulfillment, and warranty/repair — as a smooth, predictable process instead of scattered emails and spreadsheets. You'll have vetted and onboarded new dealers and distributors, negotiated the contracts that govern those relationships, represented iSonic at industry trade shows, and launched our first real lead\-generation effort for B2B accounts.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the B2B quote\-to\-order cycle — qualify inbound inquiries, build and negotiate quotes, and see orders through to fulfillment
* Run our warranty and repair (RMA) process end to end, including tracking loaner units out to customers and back
* Partner with product development, flagging recurring defects and product issues you notice through customer contact
* Vet and onboard new dealers and distributors, and negotiate the contracts and terms that govern those relationships
* Attend trade shows to represent iSonic, build relationships, and generate new B2B leads
* Build and run iSonic's first lead\-generation effort on the B2B side
* Keep customer and order records accurate and current across our CRM, QuickBooks, and Shopify

**What We're Looking For**  
**Required**

* 3\+ years in B2B account management, inside sales, or a similar customer\-facing commercial role
* Comfortable owning a CRM pipeline daily — updating stages, logging activity, keeping deals from going stale
* Strong written and phone communication skills, including direct negotiation with customers and channel partners
* Comfortable troubleshooting or discussing a physical product's issue with a customer over the phone — no engineering background required, just curiosity and patience
* Highly organized, with experience managing multiple concurrent workflows independently
* Willingness and ability to travel for trade shows

**Preferred**

* Experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM
* Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and Shopify
* Prior experience vetting, onboarding, or negotiating contracts with dealers or distributors
* Experience in a wholesale, distributor, or medical/dental\-adjacent industry
* Ability to speak and read Mandarin Chinese

**Work Location**

This is a fully on\-site role at our office: 2243 S Throop St, Chicago, IL 60608\.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a short note on your B2B account management experience to hr@isonicinc.com.

Pay: $63,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Robotics Customer Success Intern
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
====================


Each year, 2\.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics.


Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall\-E\-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self\-driving in the home” with real\-time 3D mapping, adaptive path\-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on\-device.

**Privacy First**
-----------------


What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud.

**Our Approach**
----------------


Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single\-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Matic is a tight\-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra\-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy.

**About the role**
==================


Matic is building the next generation of consumer home robotics. Small team, high ownership, moving fast. We're looking for a Robotics Customer Success Intern to own ticket resolution end\-to\-end.  

  

This is a hands\-on role. You'll be in the weeds with customers every day: running onboarding, answering tickets, and closely collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams. You'll help build the systems, playbooks, and infrastructure that let us deliver a deeply personal experience to every single customer as we grow from ten thousand to a hundred thousand and beyond.  

  

We believe that the best customer service is no customer service, a product so intuitive and reliable that customers never need to reach out. The second\-best is just\-in\-time, self\-service help that anticipates questions before they're asked. You'll build both: proactive systems that eliminate friction, and a white\-glove experience for the moments that matter most.  

  

**What you’ll do:**  

  

**Deliver a Three\-Michelin\-Star Customer Experience**

* Own tickets end\-to\-end. First response to resolution. No missed replies, no open threads, no customer left hanging.
* Diagnose bugs, walk customers through fixes, and coordinate repairs or replacements when needed.
* Escalate the hard ones to Engineering, Product, or Ops, and drive them to closure.
* Analyze customer issue data obsessively. Spot patterns across tickets. Surface recurring issues, root causes, and product gaps to the team so the same problem doesn't hit a second customer.
* Develop deep product knowledge across hardware, software, algorithms, and the Matic app. Know the product inside and out: every component, every edge case, every workaround.
* Develop and deploy AI tools such as skills and agents to improve response times and support quality, and build a feedback loop that results in continuous improvement of customer success processes

**What we look for:**

* Deep customer empathy paired with a bias toward action. You care about the customer, and you move fast to resolve the issue.
* Technical curiosity. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how a complex hardware \+ software \+ AI product works well enough to troubleshoot, explain, and advocate intelligently.
* Bachelor's degree completed or in progress. Technical or analytical background preferred.
* This role can be a path to full\-time for the right candidate, based on performance and team needs.

**What we value:**

* Customer obsession. Every interaction, every email, every call, every unboxing, should feel like the customer is the most important person in the world. Because to us, they are.
* Details, details, details. The difference between good and exceptional lives in the details. You catch what others miss and you care about things other people think don't matter.
* Ownership and follow\-through. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, you fill the gap, and you make sure it stays filled. No ball gets dropped.
* Analytical rigor. You back up intuition with data. You measure what matters, you know what good looks like, and you hold yourself and your team to it.

 **We'd love to hear from you if...**

* You're the kind of person who reads every customer review, the good ones and the bad ones, because you genuinely care about how people experience a product.
* You love the challenge of diagnosing complex, cross\-functional problems, the ones that span hardware, software, logistics, and human psychology.
* You get fired up about consumer robotics and the idea of putting an extraordinary product into people's homes.
* You're excited to do your life's work.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Weekend availability. We support our customers seven days a week, so the team rotates weekend coverage. You won't work every weekend, but you'll take your turn.

  

**Compensation:**
-----------------


Base: $25\- $35/hour.  

  

Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

new_jobs.description:
Description:

Verdugo Strategies is a progressive campaign consulting organization whose mission is to collaborate with our clients to empower people who are working to create a better world through civic engagement, community mobilization, and strategic advocacy. Our past work has included presidential campaigns, key US Senate and Gubernatorial elections, and important issue\-based advocacy efforts to create positive, progressive change.


The Canvasser is a critical field\-based role responsible for engaging the local community on important issues at public events, gatherings, and residences. The primary objective is to connect directly with the public to advance client missions, drive voter/community participation, and implement tactical field plans with discipline and professionalism. The canvasser is also responsible for collecting data from individuals on their opinions and persuading them to take actions such as registering to vote, signing petitions, and/or voting.

**MANAGERIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**


While this is an entry\-level role, experienced Canvassers may be asked to help recruit and mentor new Canvassers. Canvassers report to the Organizer and are expected to represent the Company and its clients with the highest professional standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Field Engagement:** Introduce yourself to residents door\-to\-door and/or in public places to gather their opinions on important matters.
* **Script Mastery:** Memorize and recite prepared to ensure consistent, impactful messaging.
* **Training \& Development:** Receive continuous training and participate in daily exercises to refine message delivery and tactical agility.
* **Information Gathering:** Collect contact details, signatures, and other data from community members for follow\-up.
* **Information Distribution:** Deliver flyers, door hangers, and other campaign information directly to homes.
* **Action\-Oriented Persuasion:** Use provided knowledge on candidates and policies to create voter action.
* **Operational Adherence:** Ensure compliance with all internal safety protocols, company policies, and data integrity standards.
* **Adaptive Support:** Perform other duties and follow directions as requested by the Organizer.

**SUCCESS CRITERIA**

* **Goal Attainment:** Consistently hits or exceeds outreach and information\-gathering targets.
* **Data Integrity:** Maintains 100% accuracy and honesty in data collection and reporting.
* **Professional Reliability:** Maintains seamless communication with leadership and manages field shifts with a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* **Advancement Potential:** Demonstrates excellence in the position and the ability to train others, which may lead to advancement opportunities within the organization.


Requirements:
***Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Qualifications***

* Demonstrated commitment to progressive causes and enthusiasm for working in a fast\-paced environment.
* Must be 18 years of age or older.
* Comfort with talking to people and strong face\-to\-face communication skills.
* Must be able to read, write, and understand English at a professional level to manage internal documentation and reporting.
* Ability to learn quickly during training sessions to effectively deliver campaign messages and persuade community members to take action.
* Must have a working smartphone with an active data plan for professional communication and performing duties.
* Must not be employed by another political campaign during employment of this position.
* Ability to learn and use new software programs quickly, such as mobile canvassing apps.

***Preferred Experience***

* Previous experience in community organizing, canvassing, or customer service.
* Working proficiency in a second language is highly preferred and considered a significant asset.
* Valid Driver’s License.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**


This role operates in a dynamic field office environment and in various community settings. It requires the ability to work long hours and/or weekends, especially during peak campaign phases. While some administrative work is performed in an office setting, the role is primarily active and field\-facing, and regularly requires traveling in a vehicle and walking in residential neighborhoods or public spaces speaking to community members.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**


While performing the duties of this job, this role is regularly required to walk long distances and navigate different neighborhood terrains. The employee must be able to sit for periods of training and stand for extended periods during training or field shifts. Specific physical abilities required include the ability to navigate stairs, carry heavy outreach materials, and work outdoors in varying weather conditions (heat, rain, etc.).

**EMPLOYMENT PRACTICES**


At Verdugo Strategies, we value diversity and always treat all employees and job applicants based on merit, qualifications, competence, and talent. We do not discriminate on the basis of or traits historically associated with race; color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, and any other status protected by state or federal law.

**About the Opportunity**

Innoface Systems, Inc. is seeking a motivated and highly organized Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand our commercial client base and create new sales opportunities.

We provide professional audiovisual technology solutions for businesses, government organizations, educational institutions and other commercial clients. Our solutions include conference and collaboration systems, professional audio, digital signage, video walls and integrated audiovisual environments.

This is a remote position based in the Atlanta metropolitan area. The selected candidate will primarily work from home but should be available for occasional local client meetings, networking opportunities, training and other business\-related activities as needed.

The BDR will play an important role at the front end of our sales process by identifying prospective customers, starting conversations, qualifying opportunities and helping move the right prospects into our sales pipeline.

For a high performer who demonstrates strong sales results and leadership potential, this role may provide a future pathway toward sales leadership and management of an outside sales team.
